title: Blacksmith
content:
Blacksmith

Chapter 11 Blacksmithing

"The relationship is good, I don't want to borrow much, ten golden dragons are enough." Arthur replied.

Hendry stood, holding the armrest of the seat with his left hand, and asked with a smile: "Are you pressing on yourself or on Igor Merrister?"

As soon as these words came out, there was another burst of unbridled laughter in the audience.

Arthur suddenly felt a little angry, "Of course it's me."

After another period of commotion, the opposing sides reentered the arena.

An officer from Shili City serves as the referee. His duty is to announce the rules and the identities of the two people, and to stop the behavior of both parties after one party admits defeat.

The rules are simple. Arthur and Igor wear protective gear and attack each other until one side says "I surrender", and the other side is considered victorious.

"Let us invite these two gentlemen."

"The one wearing silver plate armor and without a mask is Arthur Bracken from the Moulin Rouge. As far as I know, this is his first time participating in this kind of competition, and he has not yet achieved any success."

"Obviously, Mr. Arthur needs the blessing of the Seven Gods."

"And this, Aegor Merister, is an old friend we are familiar with."

"Now loyal to Sir Marco Piper, he has already won many battles, including defeating famous Freelancers such as Free Sterling."

Following the referee's explanation, Igor raised his right hand holding the sword and his free left hand to signal to the surrounding audience.

A large number of nobles, knights and their entourage cheered and applauded in response to Aegor's move.

In the main seat of the auditorium, Lekar Vance whispered to Hendry: "Looking at it, most of them placed bets on Igor. Although the odds are small, if Arthur wins, you have to The money lost is not a small amount of money.”

"It's just a little golden dragon." Hendry tried his best to pretend not to care, "Just treat it like making friends with everyone."

Carlyle looked at Hendry playfully and said nothing.

He knew in his heart that Hendry's inheritance rights had no legal basis.

If Lord Janos decided to pass Stonehedge and his territory to one of his five daughters, there was nothing Hendry could do.

Therefore, Hendry paid great attention to his relationship with other nobles in the river, in case he would not have the support of public opinion when a situation arises in the future.

Kalel shook his head with a smile and turned to look at the battle situation in the field.

Aegor and Arthur are similar in height, but Aegor is obviously sturdier.

The two began to circle around, and the people around them were eager to encourage Yi Ge to attack.

Of course, there are also those who are yelling at Arthur to get beaten quickly.

Arthur paid attention to the movements of the knight whose face was hidden in the mask, and felt that he was also powerful, so he no longer hesitated and picked up the sword with both hands to chop directly.

Yi Ge was also observing, but he didn't expect Arthur to dare to attack.

After leaning back to avoid Arthur's slash, Igor sneered: "You don't think you can beat me with your three-legged cat skills, do you?"

"How can you know if you haven't fought?" Arthur slashed with his sword again.

Yi Ge was ready, no longer retreating, and faced him with swords in both hands.

The two swords collided hard with a bang, and then the two began to wrestle.

The audience immediately cheered, and many people shouted to knock him down.

Obviously, this "he" refers to Arthur.

The wrestling action continued, and the audience's passion gradually faded.

Among the three people in the chair, Ma Ke looked at it the most seriously. At this time, he exclaimed softly: "This Arthur can do it. He can hold on with Igor for such a long time."

He is the lord of Yi Ge, so he naturally knows Yi Ge's strength.

"It's just that Igor didn't use his strength." Hendry said dismissively.

As soon as he finished speaking, Igor was forced to take two steps back as Arthur shouted loudly.

Arthur waved his sword and charged forward again. Aegor raised his sword to block, and there was another bang.

Karel was happy, "These two are just sitting here forging iron!"

Ma Ke turned to Kalel and said: "It's really a blacksmith. The strength of these two people should be about the same. Arthur is slightly stronger."

Hendry did not want to send troops, so he was very unhappy to see Arthur win, and sneered at these words: "Maybe Igor is hiding his strength, waiting until Arthur becomes careless, and then defeats him in one fell swoop."

"Then Yi Ge's acting skills are really great. I didn't even notice my knight." Ma Ke stared at the field. "If Arthur can win, I will beat him to win in the next round."

This time he bet on his own Yi Ge to win, and the bet was a full fifty gold dragons.

Originally, he was still thinking of getting five golden dragons from Hendry, but now he had a hunch that he might lose all his principal.

Even if he is the heir to Pink City, losing fifty golden dragons all at once is still very painful.

Kalel held the opposite opinion, "Arthur may not be able to win. Look at the situation on the field. Both of them are not very agile. Arthur's sword skills are not superb. Igor's chance of winning is still higher."

Hendry is much more confused.

On the one hand, he hoped that Yi Ge would win so that he would not have to send troops, but this meant that he had to pay dozens of gold dragons in compensation, although this was necessary to maintain a relationship.

On the other hand, he hoped that Arthur would win, so that the bet of hundreds of gold dragons on the field would be all his.

Oh, by the way, ninety more for Arthur.

Hendry blushed at his wavering position.

After all, he is not yet the legal first heir to Earl Bracken.

If he had a little more money, he wouldn't have to worry so much. If Count Genos had made it clear that he was the heir, he wouldn't have to try so hard to please these small nobles and knights.

The fight on the field has reached a white-hot stage.

Arthur kept advancing, and Iger staggered back, swinging his sword to block from time to time.

The people around him kept shouting for Iger to attack, as if it was the knight who took the initiative instead of the small noble.

But only Iger himself knew how strong the young man in front of him was.

The power that was inconsistent with his body size continued to be generated from his body, as if he would not get tired.

It was simply a human-shaped violent bear!

Every casual blow was like a sledgehammer that could not be resisted.

Iger's blade had been chopped into pits and pits.

After Arthur forced Iger back again, he knew that his opponent was about to run out of strength.

So he decided to end the fight.

Arthur raised his sword, and Iger also raised his sword defensively to block.

But Arthur made a feint and swung his sword at Aegor's left leg with one hand.

Because Aegor was preparing to use his strength to meet the attack from the front, he did not expect Arthur to attack the bottom lane. He did not have time to retract his left leg, and the armor on his left leg was cut into a big dent.

"Damn it!" He groaned in pain in his left leg.

There was a burst of boos around him.

Aegor swung his sword downward to counterattack, but he did not expect Arthur to come close to him and hit him hard.

Aegor could not exert strength on his left leg, and pushed his right foot back, but still fell down.

"Seven levels of hell."

Arthur did not miss this opportunity and swung his sword to Aegor's neck.

"I surrender, I surrender." Aegor screamed in fear.

If this sword had been cut, he would really go to the seven levels of hell.

"Arthur Bracken wins." The officer did not forget his duty and immediately announced Arthur's victory, while running over to help Aegor up.

The audience around booed loudly, and some people lost a lot of money and were cursing and greeting Aegor's female relatives for generations.

Hendry breathed a sigh of relief. Not only did he not have to pay dozens of gold dragons, but he also earned nearly ten times the money.

Now he felt that Arthur was a little more pleasing to the eye.
